title: 长篇说明文的段落功能
goal: 识别段落功能并按信息类别查找候选段。

points.label: 判断长篇说明文各段的功能
按信息类别缩小候选段范围

sources.title: 全国大学英语四、六级考试大纲（2016年修订版）

cards.title: 结构
rows: Many visitors arrive after the gate closes.
描述到达时间造成的问题。
The bus timetable explains some late arrivals.
One visitor missed the last bus connection.
The centre has added a later entry period.

cards.title: 常用表达
rows: A common problem is the lack of seating.
One reason is the early closing time.
For example, one family arrived after closing.
One response is to extend opening hours.
A section under Improving Access describes a ramp.

body.box:
A. Limited Seating
The waiting room has too few seats at busy times. Some visitors stand near the door.
B. Providing More Seats
The centre has placed folding chairs in the waiting room. Staff put them away when the room is quiet.

Statement: The centre provides extra seating at busy times.

body.p: 第一段主题句 The waiting room has too few seats at busy times 描述问题。第二段主题句 The centre has placed folding chairs in the waiting room 说明措施。
小标题 Providing More Seats 提示先查第二段。placed folding chairs 和 put them away when the room is quiet 支持陈述。

body.box:
A. Delayed Deliveries
Several deliveries reached the workshop late. The delay affected the work schedule.
B. A Change in Collection
The workshop arranged an earlier collection from its supplier. The new arrangement began on Monday.

body.p: 第一段主题句 Several deliveries reached the workshop late 描述现象。第二段主题句 The workshop arranged an earlier collection from its supplier 说明对策。两个小标题也把问题和措施分开。

cards.title: 常见错误
rows: 区分关闭时间与迟到情况。
该例只说明一家人的情况。
核对 chairs 的具体安排。

groups.text: The station has a problem with crowded platforms. Passengers often wait close to the entrance.

items.stem: What is the paragraph's main function?
options: To describe a problem of crowding
To explain a new platform design
To give a cause of empty trains
To compare two station timetables
items.why: a problem with crowded platforms 引出站台拥挤现象。

groups.text: One reason for the crowded platform is that two trains depart at the same time.

items.stem: What information does this paragraph provide?
options: A change to train seating
A cause of platform crowding
An example of a quiet platform
A proposal for later departures
items.why: One reason 引出两列车同时出发这一原因。

groups.text: A. The Problem: The footpath is often muddy. B. A Response: Workers have added a gravel surface.

items.stem: Where should a reader look for a measure to address the path?
options: The problem paragraph
Both paragraph headings
The response paragraph
Neither paragraph
items.why: A Response 和 added a gravel surface 指向铺设碎石的措施。

groups.text: A. The Reason: The bus arrives after the ferry leaves. B. An Example: One passenger missed the ferry on Tuesday.

items.stem: Where should a reader look for an individual case?
options: The reason paragraph
Both paragraph headings
Neither paragraph
The example paragraph
items.why: An Example 引出一名乘客的具体经历。

groups.text:
A. A Storage Problem
The school has too little room for sports equipment. Balls are kept in several classrooms.
B. The Cause
The original cupboard is too small for the new equipment.
C. A Storage Plan
The school will place a larger cabinet in the hall. Teachers will label its shelves.

items.stem: What is the function of the first paragraph?
options: To present a problem with storage
To give the cause of the shortage
To explain labels on the shelves
To report a cabinet's delivery
items.why: too little room for sports equipment 是储存问题。短缺的原因在第二段 The Cause。

items.stem: Which paragraph should be checked for a proposed measure?
options: The first paragraph
The third paragraph
The second paragraph
All three paragraphs
items.why: A Storage Plan 和 will place a larger cabinet 指向拟采取的措施。

groups.text:
A. Food at the Market
At the end of each market day, some sellers have fresh food left over. They may have more produce than customers have purchased. Keeping this food for another market day can be difficult, especially when sellers do not have enough cool storage. The amount left varies from one day to another and depends on what customers buy. Unsold food must therefore be handled soon after the market closes for the day.

B. A Reason for Surplus
Sellers need to estimate how much food customers will want before the market opens. If fewer customers arrive than expected, some goods remain unsold. Weather and the timing of other local events can affect attendance. An estimate helps sellers prepare, but it cannot ensure that every item will be bought on a particular day.

C. One Seller's Experience
A vegetable seller once brought extra carrots to a weekend market. Fewer customers came than the seller had expected, and several boxes remained at closing time. The seller offered the carrots to a local kitchen. The kitchen accepted them for a meal it was preparing, and the empty boxes were returned afterwards.

D. A Collection Plan
The market later arranged a collection point for food that sellers wished to donate. A local kitchen agreed to pick up suitable items after closing. Sellers could indicate what they wanted to give, and the kitchen could decide what it was able to use. The arrangement was intended to connect available food with a specific local need.

items.stem: What is the main function of the first paragraph?
options: To present the problem of food remaining
To detail the kitchen's collection schedule
To give one seller's account of carrots
To explain how customers choose a market
items.why: some sellers have fresh food left over 引出现象及储存困难。

items.stem: Which paragraph should be checked for an individual seller's experience?
options: The paragraph headed Food at the Market
The paragraph headed One Seller's Experience
The paragraph headed A Collection Plan
The paragraph headed A Reason for Surplus
items.why: One Seller's Experience 指向具体卖家和剩余胡萝卜的经历。

items.stem: What does the final paragraph primarily describe?
options: How weather and other events affect attendance
How one seller gave carrots to a kitchen
An arrangement for collecting donated food
The storage difficulty that sellers first noticed
items.why: arranged a collection point for food that sellers wished to donate 说明收集捐赠食物的安排。第二项是第三段一位卖家的个别经历。

groups.text:
A. A Waiting Problem
People visiting a repair workshop sometimes wait a long time before speaking with a technician. At busy periods, several visitors arrive together and stand near the entrance. The workshop has a small waiting area, so staff want to understand when queues form. They began by recording arrival times rather than changing the repair process immediately. The records covered both the morning and the later hours of the working day.

B. Why Queues Form
One reason for the queue is that visitors often arrive just after the workshop opens. Some want to leave an item before going to work. When several people arrive at once, the single reception desk cannot serve all of them at the same moment. Later in the day, arrivals are usually spread over a longer period.

C. A Visitor's Account
One visitor brought a bicycle lamp to the workshop on a weekday morning. Several other people had arrived shortly before, so the visitor waited near the entrance. The technician later inspected the lamp and explained the repair. This account illustrates one busy period; it does not describe every visitor's experience or every type of repair.

D. A New Appointment System
The workshop introduced a way to reserve a time for leaving an item. Visitors who made an appointment could tell staff in advance what they needed repaired. The workshop continued to accept visitors without appointments as well. Staff planned to compare waiting times before and after the change to see how the new arrangement worked.

items.stem: Which paragraph should be checked for an explanation of the queue?
options: The paragraph headed A Visitor's Account
The paragraph headed A Waiting Problem
The paragraph headed A New Appointment System
The paragraph headed Why Queues Form
items.why: Why Queues Form 和 One reason 指向排队原因。

items.stem: What is the role of the paragraph about the bicycle lamp?
options: To present a particular visitor's experience
To prescribe the workshop's repair procedure
To report results of the appointment system
To establish the reason for every queue
items.why: One visitor brought a bicycle lamp 引出一个具体经历。

items.stem: Which paragraph describes a measure intended to address waiting?
options: The paragraph headed Why Queues Form
The paragraph headed A New Appointment System
The paragraph headed A Visitor's Account
The paragraph headed A Waiting Problem
items.why: introduced a way to reserve a time 说明预约措施。
